alternatives_considered.option: All pair_result/valley_result values are actual pair or valley outcomes
alternatives_considered.reason: Every L8/L9 row is a synthetic expectation and not an executed result; this would turn fixtures into runtime evidence and conflict with not_executed/unknown-unformed audits.

alternatives_considered.option: Every value is only synthetic condition support
alternatives_considered.reason: L8 known/conflict/stale/missing state envelopes and L9 conflict/stale rows distinguish unsupported, mismatched, and foreign-revision conditions; support-only semantics cannot explain those rows.

alternatives_considered.option: Replace origin/trace supported values with missing/conflict or rewrite conflict/stale into supported
alternatives_considered.reason: Would edit expected values without an upstream L3/L10 rule and erase distinctions encoded by source_packet_ref, state tags, mutations, and per-row reasons. L4 missing finding requires a processing-result assertion that these fixtures do not contain.

alternatives_considered.option: 既存fixtureのcase別期待値を保持し、mutation軸から一般規則を推定しない
alternatives_considered.reason: 承認済みL3/L10と許可L4散文に期待値変更または値割当規則の根拠がなく、実処理出力も観測されていない。固定source上の値・mutation対応を記録し、origin/traceとpair/valleyの書き分け原理は未解決として残す。

prior_design_evidence.selected_reason: L3/L10と許可されたL4散文に期待値を書き換える根拠がなく、固定sourceに実処理結果もないため、既存値を保持する。固定行のmutationとexpected値の対応はstatus_assignment_rule_resolutionに列挙するが、その相関は値割当の一般規則を証明しない。origin/traceのsupport値はsource packetがsynthetic input conditionをsupportする期待値として残し、処理成功とは解釈しない。
prior_design_evidence.l9_values_preserved: 両witnessのpair_result/valley_result/l9_dimension_results/meaning_backflow/actual_*、classification値、manual projection invalidation row、trigger/ticket候補は維持。説明reason 4箇所の旧新値はscaffoldのwr227-l9-reason-edit-audit.jsonに履歴として記録し、expected output valuesは変えていない。

comparison_history.finding: F1 full value domain; F2 fixed blind and comparison pointers; I1 move old/new reason history to scaffold.

status_assignment_rule_resolution.finding: 固定fixtureでは、pair_result conflict/staleの6行がpaired_comparisonsを変異させ、valley_result conflictの1行がvalley witnessを変異させる。origin/traceの2行はそれぞれorigin/traceを変異させ、pair_result/valley_resultをsupported_synthetic_conditionのまま記録する。
status_assignment_rule_resolution.interpretation_limit: この行別相関だけでは、pair_result/valley_resultの期待値割当が変異軸だけに反応するという一般則や、origin/trace欠落にsupport値を割り当てる規則は導けない。L3/L10と許可されたL4散文にもその規則はない。
status_assignment_rule_resolution.preservation_basis: 上流要求の意味を変える根拠がなく、これらは未実行fixtureの期待値であるため、値は変更せず個別対応を保つ。

validation_contract: Compare every listed L8/L9 F03 row and exact partial-result fields against the source pointer.
Recompute direct value counts and nested per-layer pair_results counts; compare them with measured_counts.
Resolve all source path/pointer entries and exception row pointers.
Confirm pair conflict, pair stale, valley conflict, and unmatched L8 missing cases retain the recorded row identities and statuses.
Keep full L9 case equality against the two fixed baselines after normalizing only the four reason edits.
Do not execute L4/L5 predicates or infer a runtime result from fixture expected values.
